column1: # Errors and warnings of the test stack that are not bugs (scripts/audit-logs.mjs, run by scripts/test-airgap.sh).
# source (a container, agent-debug, or * for any) <TAB> regular expression of the signature <TAB> why it is expected.
# A signature has no times, addresses or numbers (N). Add a line only with the reason it is expected, never to make
# a run pass: an unexplained error is a bug to fix.

column2: ^sendSyncMessageWithoutResponse@interface_impl\.h: Received error from server\. .*NginxionS: the agent has no cloud
column3: The agent of NginxionS has no Fog (openappsec/agent): its calls to the cloud end here, by design

column2: ^executeHealthCheck@health_check_manager\.cc: Failed to send periodic health check patch to the fog
column3: No Fog: the health check of the cloud is not sent, by design

column2: ^loadAccessToken@agent_details\.cc: Failed to open session token file
column3: No Fog, no token of a session: the agent runs without registration, by design

column2: ^nginx: \[lua\] crowdsec\.lua:N: Allow\(\): \[Crowdsec\] denied '<ip>' with '(ban|captcha)'
column3: The bouncer logs each refused request at the error level: smoke attacks and bans the tester on purpose

column2: ^No matching files for pattern /does/not/exist$
column3: The official image of CrowdSec writes this placeholder into acquis.yaml; the sources of NginxionS are in acquis.d

column2: ^postgres: database "iNdatatubeschemasecurityeventlogsvN" does not exist$
column3: The tuning service creates its database with the first log of the agent: the first open fails by design (smartsync-tuning datatube.go InsertLog)

column2: ^postgres: relation "appsec" does not exist$
column3: The tuning service creates its table with the first log: the first insert fails by design, then the table is made

column2: ^postgres: no partition of relation "appsec" found for row$
column3: The table of the tuning service has a partition per UTC day, made by the first insert of the day (and a day ahead): that insert fails once by design

column2: ^postgres: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "pg_database_datname_index"$
column3: Parallel first logs create the database at once; the loser opens the one the other made (NginxionS: InsertLog does not drop its log)

column2: ^postgres: relation "appsec_p_N_N_N" already exists$
column3: Parallel writers create the partition of a day at once; the loser inserts into it (NginxionS: InsertLog does not drop its log)

column2: ^nginx: (connect\(\) failed \(N: Connection refused\)|\[lua\] crowdsec\.lua:N: (AppSecCheck\(\): Fallback because of err: connection refused.*|Allow\(\): AppSec check: connection refused))$
column3: AppSec of CrowdSec restarts when its settings or the engines of the WAF policy change (smoke changes them many times); meanwhile the bouncer applies failure_action (passthrough)

column2: ^getModeWithDefault@new_practice\.cc: Setting to top-level mode:
column3: open-appsec logs the normal path of an inherited mode at the error level (new_practice.cc)

column2: ^getModeWithDefault@new_practice\.cc: Given mode: or top-level: \S+ is invalid\.$
column3: An engine absent from a practice has an empty mode; open-appsec logs it at the error level and takes inactive, which is meant

column2: ^ParametersSection@rules_config_section\.cc: Illegal Parameter values\. Name and ID are empty$
column3: open-appsec adds an empty parameter to a rule with no exceptions and logs it at the error level (policy_maker_utils.cc); the rule works

column2: ^initGeoDbObj@geo_location\.cc: maxMindDB error: Error opening the specified MaxMind DB file
column3: The agent's own GeoIP database is not shipped (no cloud): NginxionS resolves countries itself (geoip/, events)

column2: ^SerializeToLocalAndRemoteSyncBaseT@Serializator\.cc: learning host name\(SHARED_STORAGE_HOST\) is not set$
column3: One agent: what it learns is kept locally, not synced to other agents through the shared storage

column2: ^pullProcessedData@(ConfidenceCalculator|TrustedSourcesConfidence)\.cc: Failed to (get the remote state|pull state data)$
column3: One agent: there is no remote state of learning of other agents to pull (see SHARED_STORAGE_HOST)

column2: ^loadFromFile@Serializator\.cc: failed to open file: /etc/cp/conf/waap/.* No such file or directory$
column3: A learned file of an asset does not exist before the agent writes it for the first time

column2: ^closeLogFile@file_stream\.cc: Failed in closing log file\. File path:
column3: open-appsec closes its log file before rotating it even when it is not open yet; the log goes on

column2: failed to compile profiles: error compiling filter of 'nginxions_ip': unexpected token
column3: smoke sets a broken profile filter on purpose (CrowdSec -> Settings) to check that NginxionS restores the previous files

column2: ^Global: NginxionS CrowdSec: not healthy after the change, restoring the previous files\.
column3: The rollback that smoke checks with a broken profile filter on purpose

column2: ^nginx: \[lua\] crowdsec(\.lua|\.conf):N:? ?\S*:?N?:? ?(init\(\): (APPSEC is enabled|error loading captcha plugin: no recaptcha site key provided)|\[Crowdsec\] Initialisation done)
column3: lua-cs-bouncer logs its start at the error level; captcha has no site key until one is set in the GUI

column2: ^nginx: \[lua\] nginxions_files\.lua:N: check\(\): \[NginxionS files\] no scan of .*: clamd unreachable: connection refused$
column3: clamd loads its signatures for a minute after File Security is turned on; uploads pass meanwhile (fail-open), as smoke waits for

column2: ^nginx: connect\(\) to unix:/run/npmplus\.sock failed \(N: No such file or directory\) while connecting to upstream$
column3: The interface while its backend restarts (smoke restarts nginxions and the agent)

column2: ^Access: \S+ (N|undefined) (validation failed|no role gives \S+|connect ECONNREFUSED <ip>)$
column3: Refusals of RBAC and input checks that smoke provokes on purpose (an analyst, a missing object) and expects

column2: ^Global: NginxionS events: the database system is shutting down$
column3: smoke restarts PostgreSQL (System -> Services) and checks the backend reconnects

column2: ^postgres: (terminating connection due to administrator command|the database system is shutting down)$
column3: smoke restarts PostgreSQL (System -> Services) and checks the backend reconnects

column2: ^nginx: access forbidden by rule$
column3: smoke checks the access lists: a denied address gets 403 from nginx
